name: Triage and route project requests with Airtable, OpenAI, Slack and Gmail

parameters.content:
## Weekly triage reporting

The reporting lane is completely separate from request intake and summarises open, blocked and unassigned work. Email delivery is optional.

## Human approval decision

A separate approval webhook looks up the pending Airtable record, applies the human decision, updates status and returns the approval outcome.

## Classification, scoring and routing

Complete requests are classified with OpenAI, scored with visible deterministic rules, and routed either to pending human approval or directly into delivery handoff.

## Request intake and validation

Webhook and manual-test inputs converge into one normalised request. The brief-completeness check determines whether the request proceeds to triage or returns clarification questions.

## Triage project requests and route approvals with Airtable and OpenAI

Validates incoming briefs, returns clarification questions when information is missing, classifies complete requests with OpenAI, applies deterministic risk scoring, persists triage state in Airtable, routes higher-risk work to a human approval endpoint, and creates a structured delivery handoff.

SETUP
• Create one Airtable table with these text fields (Triage_Score as a number): Request_ID, Request_Title, Request_Type, Requester, Requester_Email, Objective, Deliverables, Due_Date, Created_At, Status, Triage_Route, Triage_Score, Triage_Summary, Risk_Level, Recommended_Owner, Next_Action, Approval_Status, Assigned_Owner, Approver_Name.
• Add Airtable base/table IDs in each config node.
• Select Airtable and OpenAI credentials.
• Optional Slack/email nodes are disabled by default.
• Test manual intake, webhook intake, clarification, approval, rejection and weekly reporting.

CONTROLS
• Manual runs never enter Respond to Webhook nodes.
• Weekly reporting is isolated from request intake.
• High-risk requests remain pending until a separate human approval event is received.

assignments.name: objective
assignments.value: Reduce the time spent rebuilding weekly reports and improve visibility for account teams.

assignments.name: deliverables
assignments.value: Automated weekly summary, exception report and approval step before client distribution.

values.content:
You are a project triage assistant. Classify the request using only the supplied evidence.

Return valid JSON with:
request_type: one of Automation, Content Production, Data/Reporting, Integration, AI/Agent, Consulting, Other
delivery_route: short plain-English route
summary: max 80 words
risks: array of concise risks
dependencies: array
decision_needed: array
recommended_owner_type: short role label
complexity: Low, Medium or High

Do not invent budget, deadlines, systems, approvals or owners.
